subject: science
concept: Understanding that sound is caused by vibrations
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Waves) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student plucks a real or virtual string/surface and feels or observes it vibrating while producing sound
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a sound-making object to the vibration that causes its sound
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what is happening physically to create a described sound

misconception_flags: believes sound comes from an object without any physical vibration occurring

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
